name: Light box
blurb: Pictures, text and shapes that glow in a framed box. LED strips glue in through the back cover.

name: Keychain
blurb: A picture or a name traced into a flat, multi-colour tag with a ring hole.

name: Name tag
blurb: Your name on a small two-colour badge for work, events or the kids' bags. Glue a pin or magnet on the back.

name: Sign
blurb: Raised lettering on a plate: door signs, name plates, shelf labels and badges.

name: Lithophane
blurb: Your photo as a thin plate that shows the picture when a light shines through it.

name: Relief
blurb: A photo or logo as raised wall art you light from the front. Brighter parts stand out.

name: Bookmark
blurb: A slim multi-colour bookmark with your name or picture and a hole for a tassel.

name: Ornament
blurb: A round hanging ornament with a name, date or picture and a loop for ribbon.

name: Coaster
blurb: A round drink coaster with raised colour lettering or a picture.

name: Fridge magnet
blurb: A small multi-colour plaque with your words or picture. Glue a round magnet into the back.

name: Lantern
blurb: Your photo wrapped into a round lithophane lantern that glows over a tea light.

name: Stamp
blurb: Raised, mirrored lettering for ink stamps, wax seals and clay. Glue it to a block or handle.

name: QR code sign
blurb: A scannable QR code plaque for a menu, Wi-Fi, a shop counter or a website.

name: License plate
blurb: A custom plate frame or a novelty plate with your own words, font and colours.

name: Nameplate
blurb: Layered nameplates from a subject and a style, or a blank plate with your own picture.

name: Hype chain
blurb: A chunky pendant from a logo or your own text, with a printed chain to match.

name: Vase
blurb: Shape a vase with a smooth profile, flat sides, a twist or ribs. Spiral or hollow.

name: Desk organizer
blurb: A tray with your own size and number of bins, with finger scoops for small parts.

name: Pixel puzzle
blurb: Your picture as coloured square tiles and a tray to press them into.

name: Dice
blurb: Six-sided dice with rounded edges and two-colour pips.

name: Flexi animal
blurb: A print-in-place snake, fish or caterpillar with ball joints that wiggle off the printer.

name: Photo to 3D
blurb: A photo of one object turned into a solid 3D model, made in your browser. Your photo isn't uploaded.
